rawError: The origin web server did not return a complete response within the 120-second Proxy Read Timeout window. The connection was established, but the origin took too long to respond.
classification: Upstream HTTP 524 after connection established; not DNS resolution failure. Task lookup confirms terminal error and no output. No automatic retry.
